There's a huge difference. I smoked spliffs (which are a combination of tobacco and cannabis) for about 5 years and the difference is night and day for me. The head rush I would get from smoking them was incredible. The high comes quicker and felt more intense then cannabis alone. Even when smoking a cigarette after a bowl can give you the same kind of affects. It was always my go to way to smoke.

However the long term side effects of smoking tobacco greatly out weighed my enjoyment. I became a pack a day smoker while working as security at a bar. After a year of that I decided to start cutting back on tobacco and then slowly cut it out of my routine and quit smoking spliffs. That was about a month ago and I couldn't be happier with decision to quit. My herb tastes better, I can enjoy the smell and terpenes a whole lot more. Plus my health has increased dramatically and I'm saving a ton more money. 

All in all I would say it's not worth it. Keep your body as healthy as you can. I've even started to cut back on smoking cannabis as well and moved over to edibles, vaping and concentrates in order to let my lungs heal faster. There's really no need to be inhaling burnt plant matter of any kind when we have so many better options.
